description: This file defines mocked classes and structures for Udev-related functionality, including pure virtual interface class UdevImpl with virtual methods that correspond to Udev operations, and a class Udev that provides static methods delegating to an implementation. It also declares external function pointers for the Udev API functions, likely for mocking or dynamic linking purposes.
